title: Docs say an idle-wait Stop drops queued workflow continuations, but an Engram-held continuation at the queue head is kept until Resume
outcome: From the carry-confirmation review of w-f917452faa71 on 98ad64fd (Claude delegation-1e66bf2e, Note, filed as a Low on the coordinator's instruction, TermAl mailbox df007e37 #42). src/session_stop_idle_wait.rs drop_queued_workflow_continuations_keeping_held_head keeps an Orchestrator queue head that Engram holds (interrupted, waiting or carrying intent); an explicit Resume then runs it. The docs state the drop without that exception: docs/features/test-runs.md:801 ("explicit-resume latch, drops queued workflow continuations, keeps user"), docs/features/agent-delegation-sessions.md:841 ("and queues no resume prompt") and :844 ("drops queued workflow continuations"), and the docs/architecture.md Stop lifecycle block ("drop queued workflow continuations"). Fix: add the retained-head exception to each.
acceptance: Docs say an idle-wait Stop drops queued workflow continuations, but an Engram-held continuation at the queue head is kept until Resume is done
